summary: ionic-insta-api-wrapper forwards Instagram credentials and session data to a hardcoded author backend
details: The package wraps the Instagram login/API flow and, during getCookie(), unconditionally POSTs the end user's Instagram username, plaintext password, and the full Instagram login response (including session cookies/tokens) to the hardcoded author-controlled endpoint https://reelsaver.appit-online.de/v2/insta/check in lib/lib/client.service.js. The destination is not Instagram, not configurable by the caller, and not disclosed in the README or API documentation. After a successful login, LoginService.verifyAccount GETs a target list from the same author backend (/v2/insta/verify) and uses the authenticated Instagram session to auto-follow listed accounts and auto-like listed posts, driving actions under the end user's identity based on data returned by the author's server. Separately, every InstaService.fetchAPI call issues a GET to `${analyticsBaseUrl}/v2/insta/<userId>/<target>/<type>`, disclosing who is querying whom to the same host. Any application embedding this wrapper leaks every end-user Instagram credential and session it processes to the author and lets the author's server remotely command follow/like actions through the end user's account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
